headline: Approved July minutes and accepted an invitation to table at the October 29th Energy Fair.
summary: Staff reported on EV charging plans at City Hall Annex and a state technical assistance award the City has not yet accepted. Discussion turned to solar power for city buildings after the loss of the wind turbines. Members agreed to meet again in September.
decisions: Approved the July 2026 meeting minutes unanimously.
Accepted the invitation to table at the 5th Annual Energy Fair on October 29th, 2026.
Agreed to meet again in September.

decision_evidence.quote: The Clean Energy Commission has been invited to table, which they accept.
Members agree to meet in September.
